build_note: Verilator elaboration used the campaign's all-unit X_IDX=1 DPI configuration. Generated C++ was linked by the Verilator Makefile with OPT_FAST=-O0 OPT_SLOW=-O0 after the default -Os compilation of one large translation unit proved impractically slow. Compiler optimization affects simulation speed, not the RTL configuration.
claim_boundary: Reduced single-token functional gate with DPI arithmetic stand-ins, simplified X_IDX=1 indexer, and behavioral HBM timing. The 434208 simulation cycles are not a production performance estimate.
